newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's trust firm launches $30 mln onshore fund.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's trust firm launches $30 mln onshore fund.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Investment Trust Co set up a $30 million onshore fund on Wednesday for foreigners to invest in the local bond market, a company official said.
Daehan Investment, a major domestic institutional investor, designated Sunkyong Securities as a lead-manager of the fund and Korea Exchange Bank as custodian.
The payment for the funds will be closed on June 2.
"The fund is expected to begin buying bonds on the day when the payment is completed," the official said.
The official said Daehan Investment would launch another onshore fund worth $120 million this year. The company plans an onshore fund for stocks next month but nothing has yet been decided.
Daehan Investment has so far set up such bonds of $130 million for bonds and $50 million for stock investment.
